name: 79707 · Midland, TX
findings: ZIP 79707 (Midland) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79707 (Midland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 79707 (Midland) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
